articles.title: Philadelphia Science Museum Closes as Supporters Seek to Reopen It
articles.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum has closed. A foundation offered a year of funding, while supporters and city leaders seek ways to reopen it.

articles.title: Driverless Taxi Cameras Raise Questions About Rider Privacy
articles.summary: Driverless taxis use cameras inside their vehicles to help manage rides. Companies describe safety uses, while privacy experts question how passenger information may be used and shared.

articles.title: Dale Sanders Completes Appalachian Trail at 91
articles.summary: Dale Sanders became the oldest person to hike the entire Appalachian Trail at age 91. He finished the 2,198-mile route in 359 days, including a winter break.
